derivation:
by
  conv_lhs => rw [hB.spectral_theorem]
  simp only [← diagonal_sub, ← Pi.smul_def, diagonal_smul, diagonal_one, map_sub, map_one, map_smul]
explanation: This is the affine consequence of the spectral theorem under M ↦ 1 - c • M. Only routine diagonal identities and preservation of subtraction, one and scalar multiplication are needed.
